audit_items.proof_trace: All three Merkle proof usages (claimTokens, excessCapital, referrerFee) employ double-hashing (`keccak256(bytes.concat(keccak256(abi.encode(...))))`) for leaf construction, which prevents second-preimage attacks where an attacker supplies an internal node as a leaf. Solady's `MerkleProofLib.verify` correctly recomputes the root from the leaf+proof and compares against the stored root; no code path bypasses this check. A zero/unset root cannot be exploited because the double-hashed leaf is never `bytes32(0)`, and constructing a proof that hashes to zero requires a preimage attack.
